Use case: precise-object-edit / faithful photographic resolution enhancement.
Edit target: the supplied photo 1 of a real seaside basketball court. This is one of five viewpoints of THE SAME court, not a new room or a redesign.
Primary request: enhance resolution and restore conservative photographic clarity. Produce a single high-resolution 4:3 image, ideally 3072 by 2304 pixels or the highest available faithful 4:3 output.
Invariant: retain the EXACT original camera perspective, framing, horizon, architecture, court geometry and every painted line (including their existing wear or missing portions), tree positions and silhouettes, terraces, bleachers, hoop and backboard structure, shadows, brightness, colors and all people. Do not crop, move or add any object. Do not alter the weather or time of day. Do not repair the court design or make the floor glossy. The fifth view's existing wetness, if present in this target, must remain exactly as photographed.
Improve only edge clarity, aliasing and compression damage, and restrained material detail consistent with visible evidence: dry concrete texture where dry, metal, grass, palm trunks and individual frond structure. Do not invent legible signage, logos, faces, extra leaf clusters, cracks or new fixtures. No oversharpening halos, waxy denoising, HDR exaggeration, stylization, text overlays or watermark. Return only the enhanced version of this exact view, not a montage or comparison sheet.
